title: npm package.json dependencies and engines
text: ETARGET and No matching version found require checking the dependency name and the published versions in the configured registry. Dependencies use version specifications; engines describes supported Node versions. Query registry metadata before selecting a replacement version, and update the lockfile consistently.

title: Dockerfile COPY and build context
text: COPY source paths refer to the build context. A file outside that context or excluded by .dockerignore cannot be copied. For multistage builds, COPY --from selects another stage. Check source paths, stage names and the context directory when a build reports a missing source or cache key.

title: Dockerfile USER EXPOSE and HEALTHCHECK
text: HEALTHCHECK runs a command whose exit status reports container health. Ensure the probe executable exists in the final image and the selected USER can run it. EXPOSE documents a listening port; publishing ports requires runtime configuration. Check permission errors against the runtime user and writable directories.

title: Node error codes and module compatibility
text: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND concerns module resolution. ERR_REQUIRE_ESM and ERR_REQUIRE_ASYNC_MODULE concern CommonJS and ES module interoperability, with behavior depending on Node version and top-level await. Match documentation to the deployed runtime before changing imports, extensions or package type. Preserve dependency API contracts.

title: Vite environment variables and modes
text: Browser code accesses Vite environment values through import.meta.env. By default only VITE_ prefixed values are exposed to client code and their values are strings. Values are replaced at build time, so changing a container environment after building does not rewrite the bundle. Never expose a secret through a client variable.

title: Express 5 migration path syntax
text: Express 5 changes route path matching. A wildcard needs a name, such as /*splat; /{*splat} also matches the root path. Optional path segments use braces. Missing parameter name errors after upgrading require checking route strings and the installed Express version before editing handlers.

title: ECS stopped task diagnostics
text: Inspect ECS task stopCode, stoppedReason and container reasons to diagnose stopped tasks. ResourceInitializationError and CannotPullContainerError identify different startup stages. Keep structured fields alongside application logs; error wording may change. A successful local image build alone does not validate an ECS startup failure.

title: ECS execution IAM role and ECR image pull
text: The ECS task execution role lets the agent pull ECR images and send logs. It is separate from the task role used by application code. AccessDenied for ecr:BatchGetImage or ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer requires checking the execution role and repository access. Scope permissions to the required actions and resources.

title: ECS container health checks
text: ECS uses health checks declared in the task definition, with command, interval, timeout, retries and startPeriod. Check the port, path and installed probe tool inside the container. A slow startup can need a start period. Task definition checks override Docker image checks. Confirm task health in ECS after changes.

title: S3 403 AccessDenied troubleshooting
text: S3 AccessDenied can involve identity policies, bucket policies, explicit denies, organization restrictions, endpoint policies or encryption permissions. Identify the principal, requested action and resource first. A broad Allow does not override an explicit Deny. Validate access with the intended identity; do not make a bucket public to bypass an error.
